implementation.owner_boundary: Control owns the long-lived MCP process and its source reload. Environment continues to own session, campaign, claim, and checkpoint semantics.
implementation.cause: Control loads the sibling mncs-environment package into the server process. The installed path unit watched only Control Git refs, so Environment updates could leave imported Environment code stale until Control restarted.
implementation.change: The Control update path now watches HEAD, refs/heads/main, and packed-refs in both the Control and Environment checkouts. The renderer supports an explicit Environment checkout and defaults to the sibling mncs-environment repository.
implementation.security_boundary: The change reloads the existing user-scoped service. It adds no Store filesystem access for Bwrap consumers and changes no service write paths or confinement settings.
